perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: sovereignEnterpriseDistribution
factors.basis: On September 8 Nebius and Palantir announced that Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, with planned integration of Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter.

risks: Preferred-partner status and planned integration do not quantify committed revenue, customer adoption or capacity utilization.
unknowns: Integration completion date, commercial economics, minimum commitments and customer uptake were not disclosed.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: enterpriseChannelExecution
factors.basis: The partnership provides a concrete enterprise distribution/integration path beyond previously captured hyperscaler capacity contracts.

risks: Execution requires successful integration and conversion of eligible Palantir customers into paid Nebius usage.
unknowns: Revenue timing and incremental gross margin from the channel remain unknown.

sources.origin: Nebius Newsroom / Palantir sovereign AI partnership
facts: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner.
Following integration, Palantir plans to bring Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside its enterprise perimeter for eligible customers.

result: Materially different primary enterprise-channel evidence packaged for Alpha; financing, margins and numeric underwriting remain Alpha-owned.
